description: This file defines the AddressHelper class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods for converting cell addresses between R1C1 and A1 formats, parsing formulas, and retrieving locale-specific row and column characters.

classes.name: AddressHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for converting cell addresses between R1C1 and A1 formats, parsing related formulas, and managing locale-specific settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getRowAndColumnChars
methods.description: Retrieves the locale-specific characters used for rows and columns, defaulting to 'R' and 'C', with adjustment for Excel compatibility mode.

methods.name: convertToA1
methods.description: Converts an R1C1 format cell address to an A1 format cell address, considering relative references if specified.

methods.name: convertSpreadsheetMLFormula
methods.description: Processes formulas in SpreadsheetML format, cleaning up embedded references.

methods.name: convertFormulaToA1
methods.description: Converts formulas that use R1C1 or SpreadsheetML cell references to A1 references, handling quoted strings to avoid replacements inside quotes.

methods.name: convertToR1C1
methods.description: Converts an A1 format cell address to R1C1 format, optionally using current row and column for relative references.
